cur-fossil-mammoth-cave-wa.dateNote: From 1909 to 1915 Ludwig Glauert of the Western Australian Museum dug thousands of bones from this cave near Margaret River: giant kangaroos, the marsupial lion Thylacoleo and Zygomaturus. They are from the Ice Age, tens of thousands of years old (well under 0.1 million years).
cur-fossil-mammoth-cave-wa.summary: A cave near Margaret River full of the bones of Australia's Ice Age giants.

cur-fossil-devils-lair.dateNote: Ernest Lundelius first dug this limestone cave near Margaret River, Western Australia, for fossils in 1955. Later digs found stone tools, hearths and bone beads: people used the cave from about 47,000 years ago (0.047 million years), among the oldest signs of people in Australia.
cur-fossil-devils-lair.summary: A cave in Western Australia used by people from about 47,000 years ago.
